Total gross revenue 50,651 = 48,922 rental + 1,729 'Other revenue from accommodation business' (utilities/misc, NOT disclosed per property). null_recovery_round7_2026_07_03.reason: No single aggregate deal-level independent valuation figure is printed for the IPO Portfolio as a transaction. The AR only discloses (a) the acquisition value/consideration S$1,862,609k (Note 19a, p65, already captured as txn.price) and (b) PER-PROPERTY 'Valuation as at 31 December 2025' in the marketing table (p14-15, local ccy) and Portfolio Statement carrying amounts (p56, S$'000) -- both are FY-END valuations, not a valuation AT LISTING/acquisition, and are per-asset not an aggregate deal figure. Summing the per-property figures across 3 currencies (SGD/GBP/AUD) to produce a single txn-level number would require an FX conversion not printed for this purpose -- prohibited by invariant 4/3. Checked pp14-15 (marketing property tables), p27 (Financial Review valuation summary, S$1.88bn = FY-end not at-listing), p56 (Portfolio Statement), p65-66 (Note 19 Investment Properties movement/Level-3 recon). No listing-date/acquisition-date independent valuation distinct from purchase price is disclosed anywhere in the FY2025 AR.

Subsequent-event acquisition (completed 13 Jan 2026, post FY2025 year-end). Note 32 'Events Occurring After Reporting Date' (p74) states only the purchase consideration ('completed the acquisition ... for A$345.0 million ... fully financed through committed debt facilities') -- no independent valuation figure is disclosed for this deal in the FY2025 AR (it falls outside the FY2025 audited portfolio/valuation exercise). Quote: 'On 13 January 2026, the Group completed the acquisition of the 732-bed EPIISOD Macquarie Park, a PBSA asset located in Australia, for A$345.0 million.' (p74). Also checked pp1, 16, 27-30 (no valuation mentioned outside the purchase price).

RE-CONFIRMED (already noted under columns_never_fillable). Both the marketing 'Property Information as at 31 December 2025' tables (p14 SG, p15 UK/AU) and the audited Portfolio Statement (p56) disclose only 'No. of Beds' and 'Land Area (sq m)' per property -- no net/gross lettable area column exists anywhere in the report. Accommodation (PBWA/PBSA) assets are sized by bed count, not NLA -- genuine structural absence, not a miss. confirmed_absent.key: IPO Portfolio (14 assets: 5 PBWA SG + 8 PBSA UK + 1 PBSA AU)
confirmed_absent.reason: No at-acquisition (Listing Date 25 Sep 2025) independent portfolio valuation is printed distinct from the agreed price. The AR discloses only (a) the agreed acquisition value/consideration S$1,862,609k = txn.price [p54 Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows (B): 'Agreed purchase consideration for investment properties | Acquisition of the properties | 1,862,609'; p65 Note 19a: 'Acquisition value of the IPO Portfolio | 1,862,609'], and (b) a YEAR-END (31 Dec 2025) aggregate independent valuation = carrying amount S$1,884,420k [p56 Portfolio Statement 'Total | 1,884,420'; p65 Note 19a 'End of financial period | 1,884,420']. (b) is a different concept/date -- post-acquisition fair value including net fair value change (11,383) and currency translation differences (763) over the 25 Sep-31 Dec period -- NOT a deal-date appraisal, and per worklist does not qualify as valuation-at-acquisition. Deriving a deal-date number by de-composing (b) would violate invariant 3. Left null; year-end alternative recorded under flags.

Subsequent-event acquisition (completed 13 Jan 2026, after FY2025 year-end). The AR states ONLY the acquisition cost/consideration A$345.0m, never an independent valuation, and explicitly excludes EPIISOD from the FY2025 valuation exercise. Quotes: p74 Note 32 'On 13 January 2026, the Group completed the acquisition of the 732-bed EPIISOD Macquarie Park, a PBSA asset located in Australia, for A$345.0 million.'; p17 'The acquisition cost of A$345.0 million is financed 100% by the available committed loan facilities'; p17 fn1 'Valuation as at 31 December 2025 excludes EPIISOD Macquarie Park (732 beds)'; p27 'In January 2026, CAREIT completed the acquisition of the 732-bed EPIISOD Macquarie Park ... for A$345.0 million.' No valuation figure disclosed anywhere. Left null.
